title: Remove Tote from System using Hospital HMI (Remove Tote screen)
summary: Use the Hospital HMI “Remove Tote” screen to scan the tote barcode into the Tote ID and Barcode fields, verify the extract-side position information from WCS (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status), ensure the tote is positioned properly on the extract side, and then press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to remove the tote from the system.
when_to_use: When a station operator needs to remove a tote from the OptiSweep system at the Hospital Station so the required task can be performed.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the Hospital HMI “Remove Tote” workflow (scan tote barcode into Tote ID/Barcode fields, verify extract-side WCS position information, ensure tote is positioned properly on the extract side, and press CONFIRM & EXECUTE).
access_or_tools_needed: Hospital HMI access to the “Remove Tote” screen

system_preconditions: The tote is at the Hospital Station extract side and can be positioned properly on the extract side.

visual_references.description: Hospital HMI Remove Tote screen showing Tote ID and Barcode scan inputs, CONFIRM & EXECUTE button, Extract Position Information panel (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status), and the 1.1 Add Tote shortcut button.

steps.title: Open the Hospital HMI “Remove Tote” screen
steps.purpose: Access the correct Hospital HMI workflow for removing a tote from the system.
steps.instruction: On the Hospital HMI, open the “Remove Tote” screen.
steps.expected_result: The Hospital HMI “Remove Tote” screen is displayed with the Tote ID field, Barcode field, CONFIRM & EXECUTE button, and the Extract Position Information panel.
steps.healthy_condition: Extract Position Information panel is visible and ready to display WCS-provided extract-side data (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status).
steps.failure_condition: The “Remove Tote” screen is not displayed (missing Tote ID/Barcode scan inputs and CONFIRM & EXECUTE).

actions.label: Open Remove Tote screen
actions.exact_action: Open the Hospital HMI “Remove Tote” screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Remove Tote” screen is used to remove a tote from the system (Figure 4-32).

steps.title: Scan tote barcode into the Tote ID field
steps.purpose: Populate the Tote ID field using the green scanner.
steps.instruction: In the Tote ID area, use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code to populate the Tote ID field.
steps.expected_result: The Tote ID field is populated after scanning.
steps.healthy_condition: Tote ID field contains the scanned tote identifier.
steps.failure_condition: Tote ID field does not populate with the scanned tote identifier.

actions.label: Scan tote barcode for Tote ID
actions.exact_action: Use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code to populate with the tote ID.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-32: “Tote ID: Use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code to populate with the tote ID.”

steps.title: Scan tote barcode into the Barcode field
steps.purpose: Populate the Barcode field using the green scanner.
steps.instruction: In the Barcode area, press the green scanner button and then scan the tote bar code to populate the Barcode field.
steps.expected_result: The Barcode field is populated with the scanned information.
steps.healthy_condition: Barcode field contains the scanned bar code information.
steps.failure_condition: Barcode field does not populate after scanning.

actions.label: Scan tote barcode for Barcode
actions.exact_action: Press and then use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-32: “Barcode: Press and then use the green scanner to scan the tote bar code.”

steps.title: Verify Extract Position Information from WCS (extract side)
steps.purpose: Confirm the extract-side tote/AGV identity and WCS status before executing removal.
steps.instruction: Verify the “Extract Position Information” panel shows WCS data for the extract side, including AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and Status.
steps.expected_result: Extract Position Information panel displays AGV# (AGV ID), Tote ID (tote ID), Bar Code (scanned information), and Status (status messages from WCS).
steps.healthy_condition: Extract Position Information panel shows WCS-provided extract-side data (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status) consistent with the tote you scanned.
steps.failure_condition: Extract Position Information panel does not reflect the expected extract-side tote/AGV (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, or Status not matching what you expect for the tote on the extract side).

actions.label: Check WCS extract-side panel
actions.exact_action: Verify the “Extract Position Information” panel shows WCS data for the extract side, including AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and Status.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Extract Position Information (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status) does not reflect the expected extract-side tote/AGV, do not execute removal.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-32: “Extract Position Information… This is information received from the WCS. AGV#:… Tote ID:… Bar Code:… Status: Status messages received from the WCS about the tote.”

steps.title: Ensure tote is positioned properly on the extract side
steps.purpose: The system requires the tote to be properly positioned on the extract side before removal execution.
steps.instruction: Ensure the tote is positioned properly on the extract side.
steps.expected_result: The tote is physically positioned properly on the extract side of the Hospital Station.
steps.healthy_condition: Tote is correctly placed on the extract side so the removal action can be executed.
steps.failure_condition: Tote is not positioned properly on the extract side.

actions.label: Position tote on extract side
actions.exact_action: Ensure the tote is positioned properly on the extract side.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Hospital Station Operation: “Open the corresponding screen on the HMI to extract the tote from the system… Scan the tote barcode using the green scanner… If a tote is going back into the system, put the tote on the induct side (left side)… Ensure the tote is flush against the end stops.”

steps.title: Press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to remove the tote
steps.purpose: Remove the tote from the system so the station operator can perform the required task.
steps.instruction: Press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to remove the tote from the system.
steps.expected_result: The tote is removed from the system after pressing CONFIRM & EXECUTE (with the tote positioned properly on the extract side).
steps.healthy_condition: Removal completes successfully and the workflow proceeds for the station operator’s task.
steps.failure_condition: Removal is not appropriate because Extract Position Information did not match the expected extract-side tote/AGV (in that case, do not execute removal).

actions.label: Confirm and execute removal
actions.exact_action: After the tote is positioned properly on the extract side, press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to remove the tote from the system so the station operator can perform the required task.

stop_or_escalate_if: If Extract Position Information (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status) does not reflect the expected extract-side tote/AGV, do not execute removal; re-scan tote bar code into the Tote ID and Barcode fields and re-check the panel before pressing CONFIRM & EXECUTE.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-32: “Confirm & Execute Button… After the tote is positioned properly on the extract side, press CONFIRM & EXECUTE to remove the tote from the system…”

steps.title: Use the “1.1 Add Tote” shortcut only if you need to navigate
steps.purpose: Provide a navigation option to the Add Tote screen when needed.
steps.instruction: Use the “1.1 Add Tote” shortcut button only if you need to navigate to the Add Tote screen.
steps.expected_result: You navigate to the “Add Tote” screen only when required.
steps.healthy_condition: You remain on the Remove Tote screen unless navigation is necessary.
steps.failure_condition: You navigate away from the Remove Tote screen when not needed.

actions.label: Navigate to Add Tote (if needed)
actions.exact_action: 1.1 Add Tote Button A shortcut button to the “Add Tote” screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-32: “1.1 Add Tote Button A shortcut button to the ‘Add Tote’ screen.”

success_criteria: Tote is removed from the system after pressing CONFIRM & EXECUTE with the tote positioned properly on the extract side.
Extract Position Information panel shows WCS-provided extract-side data (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status) for the tote/AGV being removed.
healthy_conditions: Extract Position Information panel displays AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, and Status messages received from WCS for the extract side.
Tote ID and Barcode fields are populated via green scanner scans.
failure_conditions: Extract Position Information (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status) does not reflect the expected extract-side tote/AGV.
Tote ID and/or Barcode fields do not populate correctly after scanning.
escalation_guidance: If Extract Position Information does not match the expected extract-side tote/AGV, do not execute removal; re-scan tote bar code into the Tote ID and Barcode fields and re-check the panel before pressing CONFIRM & EXECUTE.

screens_or_images.description: Hospital HMI Remove Tote screen (Figure 4-32) showing scan fields, Extract Position Information panel, CONFIRM & EXECUTE, and 1.1 Add Tote shortcut.
Hospital Station layout diagram (page 92) to visually confirm extract-side vs induct-side placement context.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-32 (Hospital HMI Remove Tote Screen) describes scanning tote bar code into Tote ID/Barcode fields using the green scanner and pressing CONFIRM & EXECUTE after the tote is positioned properly on the extract side; includes Extract Position Information from WCS (AGV#, Tote ID, Bar Code, Status) and a shortcut button to the Add Tote screen.
